title: Windowed run characterization
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $s,N\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\mathrm{upd}$ update an auxiliary value from an optional Boolean symbol, and let $c$ be a configuration and $\tau$ an auxiliary value, with $c$ in the window of radius $s$. Then there is an $r\le N$ such that the configuration returned by the windowed run is exactly the configuration reached by $M$ after $r$ steps; every configuration up to and including step $r$ is in the window, and every configuration before step $r$ is nonhalting. If the run reports halting, then $r<N$ and the configuration at step $r$ is halted; if it reports leaving the window, then $r<N$, the configuration at step $r$ is nonhalting, and its next configuration is outside the window; if it reports exhaustion, then $r=N$.
hypotheses_covered: A multi-tape Turing machine over Boolean symbols
An update function on auxiliary values and optional Boolean symbols
An initial configuration $c$ in the window of radius $s$
